---
title: "Condition-specific mixed-effects models"
output: html_document
---

Models are first fitted in the voluntary condition for all retained regions. Regions with at least one neural predictor having p < 0.05 are then fitted in the involuntary condition using the same nine-predictor model. The intercept is excluded from screening. The response remains in milliseconds. The nine neural predictors are standardized separately within each condition after trial matching. Each model includes a participant random intercept and is fitted by maximum likelihood. ITPC is a participant-by-condition feature repeated across that participant’s trials. Coefficient p-values are two-sided.

## Read data

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
root <- Sys.getenv("DUAL_AGENCY_ROOT", unset=getwd())
while(!file.exists(file.path(root,"dual-agency-pathways.Rproj"))) {
  parent <- dirname(root)
  if(identical(parent,root)) stop("Open the project or set DUAL_AGENCY_ROOT.")
  root <- parent
}
source(file.path(root,"analysis/common.R"),encoding="UTF-8",local=TRUE)
out <- out_dir("05_LMM"); model_cache <- cache_dir("05_LMM/models")
```

```{r read-model-data}
source(file.path(project_root,"analysis/05_LMM/fun_lmm_split.R"),encoding="UTF-8",local=TRUE)
w <- read_functional_windows() %>%
  mutate(roi=gsub("-","",region))
```

## Fit and compare models

```{r fit-models}
screen_alpha <- .05
tables <- list(); counts <- list(); voluntary_fits <- list()
fit_condition <- function(one,condition) {
  filename <- paste0(one$roi,if(one$binding=="action")"_action_ba.csv"else"_outcome_bs.csv")
  fit <- run_lmm_split(file.path(cache_root,"05_LMM/features",filename),
    file.path(data_root,"05_LMM/behavior_single_trial.csv"),
    scale_features=TRUE,condition_levels=condition,exclude_subjects=NULL)
  fit
}
record_fit <- function(fit,one,tag) {
  tables[[tag]] <<- mutate(fit$fixed_table,binding=one$binding,roi=one$roi,.before=1)
  counts[[tag]] <<- fit$data %>% count(condition,subject,name="n_trials") %>%
    mutate(binding=one$binding,roi=one$roi)
}
# Screen all regions using the voluntary models.
for(i in seq_len(nrow(w))) {
  one <- w[i,]
  condition <- if(one$binding=="action")"va_a"else"vs_s"
  tag <- paste(one$binding,one$roi,condition,sep="_")
  fit <- fit_condition(one,condition)
  voluntary_fits[[tag]] <- fit
  record_fit(fit,one,tag)
}
voluntary_results <- bind_rows(tables)
followup_regions <- voluntary_results %>%
  filter(term!="(Intercept)",is.finite(p_value),p_value<screen_alpha) %>%
  distinct(binding,roi)
# Fit involuntary models only for regions selected in the voluntary screen.
followup_windows <- semi_join(w,followup_regions,by=c("binding","roi"))
for(i in seq_len(nrow(followup_windows))) {
  one <- followup_windows[i,]
  condition <- if(one$binding=="action")"ia_a"else"is_s"
  tag <- paste(one$binding,one$roi,condition,sep="_")
  fit <- fit_condition(one,condition)
  record_fit(fit,one,tag)
}
fixed <- bind_rows(tables)
```

## Save results

```{r save-results}
write_csv(fixed,file.path(out,"fixed_effects.csv"))
write_csv(bind_rows(counts),file.path(model_cache,"matched_trial_counts.csv"))
write_csv(w,file.path(model_cache,"windows_used.csv"))
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(fixed,digits=4)
```
